text.tspan: SQSO-HW-DIAG-001 · preliminary · dashed = part not selected (TBD) · TBR = value not confirmed
Sources: hardware/rf/TRANSMITTER_DESIGN.md 7.2-7.3 (LPF), 8 (monitors), 10.1 (OBC interface); hardware/rf/RF_ELECTRICAL_DESIGN.md (LNA); docs/hardware/PARTS_LIST.md (SAW); BASELINE 7
7-pole LPF, f_c 160 MHz: TRANSMITTER_DESIGN 7.3 values. Ideal-part ABCD check:
-0.1 dB at 145.9 MHz, -50 dB at 2f, -77 dB at 3f; meets 7.2 (> 50 / > 60 dB) and the BASELINE
3rd-harmonic target. Values are not the textbook 0.5 dB Chebyshev prototype; confirm by EM test (TBR).
